title: docs(eval): the daily MCP ask round and the weekly skills eval round in the eval charter, and the ask round's procedure in scenario-eval
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Part of #34869. Part of #34764.

#34764 is closed by hand when this lands: its runner merged as f012183bc4, and this PR carries the eval charter line its card still owes.

For #34869 this is slice 1, the text half: the eval charter line and the scenario-eval round procedure. The daily runs themselves wait for #34687's ask mode to install a build; the seat arms the routine later. This PR creates no trigger or routine.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Landing order: this lands before #34110 (seat 3 ruling); #34110 rebases after and pins the scenario-eval line ceiling at the merged count.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：评测章程 `lanes/eval.md` 增加 ⑤「MCP 问数日轮」(开源跑分器 ask 模式、本地起应用、订阅登录、不读 cloud 仓,与 ② 产品内问数基线并列并写明两者各读什么)和 ⑥「技能评测」(`pnpm skill-evals` 每周以订阅跑已发布技能的评测用例，带/不带技能两臂，一轮一张带全分的 `eval-run`,带技能仍败以 `finding` 报 `domain:skills`);内部技能 `scenario-eval` 在原有 §0–§5 里加入问数日轮的跑法与记录要求。
- **为什么改**：#34869 上您的原话「是否应该改成测试 mcp」「而且开源项目应该就可以测试，不需要访问 cloud」「至少每天一次吧，应该用本地 Claude code 的套餐对吧」;此前没有任何按日程经 MCP 问数的轮次。⑥ 依 #34764 的裁决(S2 A;技能评测分数「A 进本仓带全分,同场景卡」,评论 6946545946),跑分器已合入(f012183bc4),首轮记录是 eval-run #34842。
- **风险与回滚**：只改两份内部规则文字(`.claude/**`,Tier S),不发布任何包、不动代码;`lanes/eval.md` 从 45 行降到 44 行(上限 45,不抬上限),靠删重复内容腾出位置(两行重复与「交接」标题;交接那一行原样保留，挪到地盘一节末尾)。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` §1「问数日轮尚未能跑」一条(对 #34687 未落地部分的表述)与 §5 泄露数一条;`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` 的 ⑤ ⑥ 四行、第 38 行全分的放宽，以及末行保留的交接一行。
- **两分钟验证**：`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期看到 `lanes/eval.md is 44 lines (ceiling 45; headroom 1)`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/eval.md` (45 → 44 lines, ceiling 45 unchanged, widest line 120 bytes):
  - line 7: the weekly cadence names item ⑥ beside the scenario cards, and the daily cadence names item ⑤ beside the 问数 baseline;
  - new item ⑤ (two lines): the MCP 问数 daily round, on the open runner's ask mode over the cards that carry datasets, with local boot, a subscription login and no cloud repository read; and what each measurement answers: ⑤ reads the server side (matching, compilation, permissions, labels) with a general client, while ② reads the product's own agent, stays the bar for it, and keeps its cadence;
  - new item ⑥, the skills eval (two lines). The published skills' eval cases (`skills/*/evals/*.json`) run weekly through `pnpm skill-evals` in `@objectstack/scenarios` on the subscription login, in a with-skill arm and a no-skill arm. Each round files one `eval-run`, and a with-skill failure goes to `domain:skills` as a `finding`. The runner's own guard refuses an API-billed login (`packages/qa/scenarios/README.md`, `skill-evals`, Login). Item ⑥ is the next free number after ⑤;
  - the output line: ①, ⑤ and ⑥ file `eval-run` records, ① and ⑤ through `scenario-eval`;
  - the boundary line on full scores now reads scenario cards and ⑥: skills-eval `eval-run` records carry full scores in this repository, per the maintainer's ruling on #34764 (comment 6946545946, 「A 进本仓带全分,同场景卡」);
  - paid for by deleting duplicated text. Two lines: `问数基线 ② 的数字仍不对外…` (the line above already says no accuracy number is published, only scenario-card `eval-run` records), and the second hand-over line (it repeats the cadence and venue in lines 7 and 12-13, and the inclusion conditions in lines 14-15). The `## 交接` heading and its blank lines also go. Its other line, the cloud scenario-library hand-over, is kept verbatim from main as the last line of the territory section (fix round 1, seat ruling).
- `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` (131 → 165 lines). Each entry is marked 「问数日轮」 inside the existing sections, not as a parallel copy:
  - intro: the round is one kind of round of this skill, ask mode only;
  - §0: local boot, subscription login, no API spend, no cloud repository. The runner refuses an API-billed login itself: `assertSubscriptionLogin` in `packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts` throws `ApiBillingRefusedError` when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` / `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` is set or `claude auth status` reports an API-key login;
  - §1: the cards are those carrying `datasetQuestions`, re-read with `grep -l` (on main: `order_to_cash`, `travel_expense`). Only `--modes ask --template F` runs, one card per command, because a template whose namespace is not the card's is skipped. Cadence is `--ask-repeats 1` daily and `--ask-repeats 5` weekly; operations run once (README, Repeats). A start-gate entry: the round starts after #34911 (ask mode falls back to a managed install on `422 UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE`) and #34882 (`asked-back` no-figure leaves out a count of the candidates and a year written alone) have both merged. Before starting, the reader checks once that both have merged. The reason given: the unmanaged door refuses a package carrying a `capability` item (`allowRuntimeCreate: false`), measured on the #34687 thread with `travel_expense`;
  - §2: `--ask-model` and `--ask-effort` explicit on every command; with and without `--ask-skills DIR` are two configs, because `summary` refuses to table runs whose skills differ. Turns record `requestedModel`, the served `model` and `requestedEffort`;
  - §3: the daily round reports counts and trend, and the weekly round ranks. `summary` refuses to mix runs with different `--ask-repeats`;
  - §4: an ask-mode example command;
  - §5: the record names the runner sha (`env.framework`), the package source (`env.packagesLine`), the build's file name and sha256 (`template`), the ask skills (`driver.askSkills`, or `none`) and the served model (`Run · model`), and adds a `Run · datasets` column. The leak count reads as server-side: question turns are asked by member personas (`role: 'user'`, the card's permission set, their own API key) through `/api/v1/mcp`, and admin-asked dataset questions are not in that count.

## Fix round 1

Head 657d8484 → 2f66ea60, one commit, no force-push. For L1-c ACCEPT 6953979710, S1, and the seat's ruling on the hand-over line.

- **S1** (`scenario-eval/SKILL.md`): the bullet 「问数日轮尚未能跑」 described the code in the present tense, which would turn false when #34911 and #34882 land. It is now 「问数日轮的开跑条件」, a condition the reader checks: 日轮在 #34911 与 #34882 都合并之后开跑;开跑前查一次两者已合并. The §4 comment now reads 「先查 §1 的开跑条件」. Same line count (4 lines, 165 total). `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` is outside `check:pm-skill-id-lint`'s scan set (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`, `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `skills/**`), so the PR numbers stay; the gate is green. Carriers confirmed on GitHub: #34911 is "ask mode installs a build the unmanaged door refuses UNMANAGED_INSTALL_UNCOPYABLE managed instead" (Part of #34687), and #34882 is "asked-back no-figure ignores a count of the candidates and a year written alone" (Part of #34687). Both are open.
- **Hand-over line** (`lanes/eval.md`): the cloud scenario-library hand-over line is restored, byte-identical to main (`grep -cFx` = 1 on both trees). It sits as the last line of 地盘 without its `## 交接` heading: heading and blanks would take the file to 47 lines, over the ceiling of 45. The file is 44 lines. The other deleted lines stay deleted.

## Why

The only 问数 baseline on record tests the product's own agent in a hosted environment. What an open-source user gets when they connect their own client to a self-hosted app over MCP is measured by nothing on a schedule. The maintainer's words are quoted in the 维护者速读 above. Rulings: #34659 D6 = A, D7 = A (comment 6940528935). Item ⑥: #34764's card orders the charter line (S2 A from #34691, comment 6943116536), and the maintainer ruled the full-scores question on #34764 (comment 6946545946). The first skills round on record is eval-run #34842.

**Correction to the card's Evidence:** the card, and this slice's order, call the product baseline (`lanes/eval.md` item ②) a per-release baseline. On main it already runs daily (#34632 D3 as corrected, landed in 07f2861f; `lanes/eval.md` lines 7 and 21 on main, 7 and 25 on this head). It does not run per release. This PR leaves that cadence unchanged.

## Tests

None: rule text only, no tested behaviour, no ablation. Control-byte self-scan on both files: no match.

## Acceptance notes

- `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` carries no line ceiling on main. #34110 would add one at 156 lines; see the landing order above.
- `lanes/eval.md` is scanned by `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, so it cites no issue number. `scenario-eval/SKILL.md` is outside that scan, and it names #34687 for the pending parts, as the slice order asks.
- No changeset: `.claude/**` ships in no package, hence `skip-changeset`.
- Governed surface: `.claude/**` ×2, Tier S (`check-governed-merges --branch`). It lands on a PASS contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

## Verification

Derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at the final head: 19 commands (the same list as at the first head). Each exit was captured before any pipe, and all are 0: check-closing-keyword-parity (and `--self-test`), check-comment-mask-corpus, check-harness-current `--self-test`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:adr-anchors`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:gitlink-declared`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-settings-deny-roster`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` (119 files clean), `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (`lanes/eval.md` 44 lines, ceiling 45, widest table row 0), `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:watch-hint-literal`. `check:doc-formula-expressions` ran after building the `@objectstack/lint` closure under `os-verify-lock` (VERDICT command-exit 0). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 19 derived, 19 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, a derived zero (every line carries its exit code). `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate. `overlap-check`: `VERDICT overlap exit 1`, only #34110 on `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md`; it was pushed on seat 3's ruling. CI: read the PR's check-runs.

</details>

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 维护者速读 section is Chinese by the seat's form)
